description: Returns selling advice published on the site (follow-ups, proposal structure, qualification, pricing, negotiation, tenders), each with its page to quote. Use it for a method question that does not depend on the product: how many follow-ups without being pushy, what goes in a proposal, how to qualify a deal. When the buyer describes their own problem and asks how the product helps, use resoudre_probleme; for a product fact, chercher. Returns advice only, no product features or prices.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

requete.description: Words to look for in the advice.

secteur.description: Sector of the buyer, when known (agences, conseil, esn, saas).

sujet.description: Topic: closing, relances (follow-ups), structure, qualification, prix (pricing), negociation, appels-offres (tenders), cycle.
